# Psalm 148 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Praise YHWH from the-heavens; praise-him in-the-heights.

**2** Praise-him all his-angels; praise-him all his-hosts.

**3** Praise-him sun and-moon; praise-him all stars-of light.

**4** Praise-him heavens-of the-heavens, and-the-waters which above the-heavens.

**5** Let-them-praise the-name-of YHWH, for he commanded and-they-were-created.

**6** And-he-established-them to-forever and-ever; a-decree he-gave and-not it-will-pass-away.

**7** Praise YHWH from the-earth, sea-monsters and-all deeps,

**8** Fire and-hail, snow and-smoke, wind-of storm doing his-word,

**9** The-mountains and-all hills, tree-of fruit and-all cedars,

**10** The-beast and-all cattle, creeping-things and-birds-of wing,

**11** Kings-of the-earth and-all peoples, princes and-all judges-of the-earth,

**12** Young-men and-also maidens, old-men with youths.

**13** Let-them-praise the-name-of YHWH, for exalted his-name alone; his-majesty above earth and-heavens.

**14** And-he-has-raised a-horn for-his-people, praise for-all his-faithful-ones, for-sons-of Israel people-of his-nearness. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **148:1-14**: The comprehensive cosmic praise psalm: heaven (vv. 1-6) and earth (vv. 7-12) called to praise; no category of existence is excluded.

— EMET
